hosted_observation: Fresh PR observation matched the exact parent: eight successful platform build entries; publication skipped.

image.description: Fresh actual StructureEngine/private-authority CLI exit 0 and result; labels production integration and qualification false.

implementation.publication: Under actual engine authority lock, require exact captured root identity and matching disk generation; strict file publication is followed by a preallocated root assignment. File-generation outcomes use existing exact-byte recovery.
implementation.root: Private volatile root contains frozen geometry, copied model library, immutable final-cell index, source revision and saved generation. Stable snapshot views capture one root.
implementation.scope: Tools-only StructureEngine.Authority adapter; no LocalGame, server, production save format or admission changes.
implementation.staging: Clone private world/index under authority lock, apply prepared engine cells off-lock, build bounded final-cell regions directly, capture dependencies and force a private file.
implementation.world_identity: Loading requires seed and terrain generator version to match stored region identity.

initial_compile_correction: The initial rotation-loop rejection lambda captured a changing loop variable. Introduced an effectively final pose before final compilation and executed checks.
limitations: Private geometry/dependency generations are not complete world saves: inventories, player/transient metadata and unplaced model-library assets are not retained by this manifest. Synthetic direct edits are dirty until a later successful publication; ordinary edit autosave is not implemented. Runtime undo ledger is not restored after restart. Root snapshots and logical interleaving hooks are tested, not 32 concurrent rendered clients. Stage still copies a whole bounded final-cell index and validates full private files; no peak-memory, disk-durability, 100 ms owner-thread or full-city performance claim. Existing private codec caps and production development caps remain. Unknown I/O after the publication point still needs reload/recovery; no universal rollback claim.
next: Preserve complete legacy world metadata/assets, integrate responsive versioned region save/load and live publication in actual clients/server, then qualify undo/late-join transfer and full fixtures. Measure retained root generations plus undo together.
playtest: Playtest: actual CLI ran the production engine API through 11 successful placements, five successful undos and 36 expected rejection cases. It exercised four rotations, relevant overlap/stale/disk-failure edges and unrelated-edit/snapshot/restart regressions; all passed. Actual child exit 0 and JSON result were captured on the assigned display and visually inspected. Browser/game playtesting does not apply to this tools-only adapter; all 224 production/harness source hashes remain unchanged.
qualification: Full city/maximum admission,20-run memory/frame/tick/traffic budgets, directory/power-loss durability and physical-GPU/shaped-network/32-rendered-client qualification remain pending. No readiness or stable rollout claim.

cases: Actual engine placements and undo in all four rotations; anchor alignment, fractional geometry and component definitions preserved across private restart loading.
Occupied overlap rejection and empty-source terrain preservation; unrelated later edit survives undo.
Old snapshot geometry and model state stay stable across placement and undo; returned model-library copy cannot mutate a root.
Deterministic edit between file staging and apply makes exact root stale; it rejects without placing cells or losing the intervening edit, then retry succeeds.
Changed placed cells make real Engine.undo reject without altering the current root or saved bytes.
A separate authority publishes a newer disk generation; a stale in-memory root cannot overwrite it.
Injected force, move and unsupported-atomic failures leave cells/models/file/undo unpublished, release busy state and delete private stages; retries succeed.
Cancellation after actual file force leaves no root/model publication or stage; retry succeeds.
Injected exception and cancellation after actual rename recover the committed generation and root; subsequent real engine undo succeeds.
Wrong world seed or terrain version rejects loading; invalid edits, unknown model references and unlocked Commit.apply reject.
Direct final-cell indexing avoids global Edit replay and rejects duplicate/invalid cells, wrong resolution/version, count/leaf budgets and cancellation.
